title: Local script and sidecar input byte pinning
summary: Interpreter SHA-256 was insufficient when the script was an independent file. dev9 automatically pins explicit local Python/shell/ooRexx script arguments, supports up to sixteen distinct --pin-file inputs, rejects symlink pins, and includes those hashes in review/execution authority.
invariants: Local only: remote file pin claims are refused.
--pin-file precedes --; later tokens remain exact executable arguments.
File content drift after preview or review invalidates authorization; no silent retry or repair.
Imported modules, environment state, generated paths, nested commands and remote executables are not transitive closure.
Hash check just before process launch still has filesystem TOCTOU risk; a content-addressed isolated execution environment would be needed for stronger containment.
Existing dev8 jobs retain existing definition hashes but receive new observed authority fields; do not overclaim identical environment semantics.
